title: Analytical Fock-State Generation and SWAP using a Rabi-Driven Transmon
summary: Deterministic Fock-state generation and inter-mode SWAP are foundational primitives for bosonic quantum computing, yet most implementations rely on numerically optimized pulses, per-state calibration, strong dispersive coupling, or higher transmon levels, each adding control overhead that grows with system size. We present an analytical, calibration-light protocol operating entirely within the two-level g-e manifold of a weakly dispersively coupled transmon.
